items.exampleEn: He feels lonely in the big city.
items.exampleZh: 他在大城市裡覺得很孤單。

items.exampleEn: She is shy, so she does not talk much.
items.exampleZh: 她很害羞，所以不太說話。

items.exampleEn: My cat is very lazy. It sleeps all day.
items.exampleZh: 我的貓很懶，整天都在睡覺。

items.exampleEn: Don't be rude to your teacher.

items.sentenceEn: Don't be lazy. Do your homework now.

items.audioEn: My new classmate is shy, but she is very clever.
items.audioZh: 我的新同學很害羞，但她非常聰明。
items.questionZh: 說話者覺得新同學怎麼樣？

items.sentenceEn: The class is not boring at all.
I feel lonely when my family is away.
items.sentenceZh: 家人不在時，我覺得很孤單。

items.stemEn: It is ____ to talk with food in your mouth.
items.stemZh: 嘴裡有食物時說話很沒禮貌。

items.stemEn: Our coach is very ____. We must be on time.
items.stemZh: 我們的教練很嚴格，我們一定要準時。

items.passageEn: Sam is a new student. He is shy, and he feels lonely at first. Some students say he is boring, but that is rude. He is very clever, and he is not lazy. Our strict math teacher likes him a lot. Now I am his friend.
items.passageZh: Sam 是新同學。他很害羞，一開始覺得很孤單。有些同學說他很無聊，但這樣說很沒禮貌。他非常聰明，而且一點都不懶。我們那位嚴格的數學老師很喜歡他。現在我是他的朋友了。

questions.questionZh: 數學老師是什麼樣的人？

referenceEn: My little brother is very shy.
rubricZh: 「弟弟」可寫 little brother、younger brother，寫 brother 也可以
shy 可放在 be 動詞後（例如 is very shy），也可放在名詞前（例如 a shy boy）

referenceEn: Waiting in line for a long time is boring.
It is boring to wait in line for a long time.
rubricZh: boring 形容讓人覺得無聊的事
可寫，例如 Waiting in line for a long time is boring、It is boring to wait… 等
